## Summary

I implemented a mechanism to keep the storyboard receiving `Update()` ticks even while fully dimmed and invisible, preventing stutter when it becomes visible again.

**`osu.Game/Storyboards/Drawables/DrawableStoryboard.cs`**
- Exposed a public `AlwaysPresent` property (`new`, forwarding to the framework's `protected internal Drawable.AlwaysPresent`). Setting it to `true` keeps the drawable's update loop running while invisible, so its clock stays synchronized.

**`osu.Game/Screens/Play/DimmableStoryboard.cs`**
- Added `updateAlwaysPresent(bool)` which sets `AlwaysPresent = true` on both the dim `Content` container and the inner `DrawableStoryboard` when the "show storyboard" setting is enabled (and back to `false` when disabled).
- Wired it into the `ShowStoryboard` binding in `LoadComplete` so it fires immediately and on every change.
- Also called it in `onStoryboardCreated`, since the `DrawableStoryboard` may load asynchronously after the binding first fires, ensuring the newly-created instance inherits the correct `AlwaysPresent` state.
- Added the `osu.Framework.Graphics` using for the doc-comment `cref` references (osu treats doc warnings as errors).

The existing `ShowDimContent` logic still fades `Content` to alpha 0 at dim level 1.0, but with `AlwaysPresent = true` the container and storyboard children continue receiving `Update()` calls, so playback stays in sync with the game clock.

I did not touch anything under `tests/`.
